_source: Proofs and labels from outside this repository, as read on 12 November 2026. 'prs': pull requests open (not merged, not reviewed by the maintainer) on github.com/ccz181078/busycoq that contain a Rocq proof about the machine; none was compiled here unless a machine's own status.json says so. 'merged': proved in busycoq's BB6 branch. 'tracker': the class the community's BB(6) tracker spreadsheet gives the machine and whether its 3 November 2026 edition lists it as a cryptid; heuristic labels, not results. 'coq_here': Coq proofs in this repository, on busycoq's definitions. Edit by hand, then run python3 holdouts/build_pages.py.
